title: MiSeGuard Configuration
description: Configuration schema for MiSeGuard deterministic agent circuit breaker and MCP proxy

$schema.description: URL to the MiSeGuard JSON Schema for validation and IntelliSense

mode.description: Execution policy mode. In strict mode, Yellow caution actions trigger ephemeral dry-run or block. In permissive mode, Yellow actions pass through with warnings.

thresholds.description: Customizable risk score boundaries for triggering circuit breakers or sandbox simulations.

block.description: Risk score (0-100) threshold at or above which the circuit breaker trips and blocks execution (Red tier).

dryRun.description: Risk score (0-100) threshold at or above which caution inspection / ephemeral sandbox dry-run is triggered (Yellow tier).

allowlist.description: Glob patterns or commands that are unconditionally permitted (Green tier, Score 0).

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns of sensitive files or paths that will elevate risk score directly to Red (>= 70) upon access or mutation attempt.
